verdicts.reason: A keeps the headline on one line and spreads the content well down the tall frame, with the peach circle at bottom-left as in the original. But the headline runs nearly edge to edge with thin side margins, and there is a slack gap between the bottle and the headline. B breaks the headline so 'fizz' sits alone on its own line, crowds the headline, subhead and CTA together, and leaves about 80px of empty space at the bottom. It also moves the peach circle up to the top-left, where it crowds the SOLSTICE logo and changes the original's layout.
